verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of an overage fee schedule for bandwidth, invocations, or build minutes. Community comments only say Render's base pricing is easy to understand, or that component prices sit behind per-item clicks. Neither establishes published overage rates for exceeding plan limits.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know the exact overage fee schedule for exceeding plan usage limits (bandwidth, invocations, build minutes) before I get billed
